## 2. DETAILED CLINICAL SERVICES & PROCEDURES

### 2.1 Custom Hair Patching System
- Canonical Route: `https://ozzonehair.com/services/#hair-patching`
- Clinical Description: Non-surgical hair restoration addressing Norwood stage 2 to 5 alopecia. A custom template of the client's bald area is taken using contour film. The unit is constructed with human hair hand-knotted to an ultralight lace or skin base.
- Base Materials:
  - *Swiss Lace:* Thinnest, most breathable mesh, undetectable front edge, ideal for hot tropical climates.
  - *French Lace:* Slightly thicker perimeter with reinforced durability, excellent for moderate sweat.
  - *Polyurethane Thin Skin (0.03mm - 0.08mm):* Vacuum suction adherence feel, zero knots visible.
- Time Required: 90 minutes from arrival to styled completion.
- Cost: Packages starting at ₹9,999.

### 2.2 Dermatological Hair Bonding
- Canonical Route: `https://ozzonehair.com/services/#hair-bonding`
- Clinical Description: The hair system is anchored to the scalp using FDA-cleared, dermatologically tested hypoallergenic liquid copolymer adhesives (such as Walker Ultra Hold or Ghost Bond).
- Waterproof & Sweatproof Rating: 100% moisture barrier. Formulated to withstand Kerala's heavy monsoons, coastal sea breezes, helmet sweat, and daily gym workouts.
- Hold Duration: 4 to 6 weeks between routine salon maintenance cycles.
- Cost: Packages starting at ₹12,499.

### 2.3 Non-Surgical Hair Weaving (Micro-Tracking)
- Canonical Route: `https://ozzonehair.com/services/#hair-weaving`
- Clinical Description: Completely adhesive-free, mechanical hair replacement method. The perimeter of the hair unit is woven into client's existing side and back hair using micro-silicone coated links or surgical thread tracks.
- Best Suited For: Clients with hyper-sensitive scalp dermatosis, psoriasis, or adhesive allergies.
- Cost: Packages starting at ₹11,999.

### 2.4 Full Cranial Prosthesis & Replacement
- Canonical Route: `https://ozzonehair.com/services/#non-surgical-replacement`
- Clinical Description: Total scalp hair restoration system for Norwood scale 6–7, Alopecia Totalis, Alopecia Universalis, or chemotherapy hair loss.
- Coverage: Full perimeter ear-to-ear and forehead-to-nape.
- Cost: Packages starting at ₹18,500.

### 2.5 Women's Silk Crown Toppers & Extensions
- Canonical Route: `https://ozzonehair.com/services/#womens-hair-extensions`
- Clinical Description: Discreet, volumizing hairpieces designed specifically for female pattern hair loss (Ludwig Scale), crown thinning, and postpartum diffuse alopecia.
- Technology: Triple-layer Silk Top that mimics genuine skin with hair emerging without visible knots. Fastened via micro-clips or integration tracks.
- Privacy: Handled in 100% private, female-dedicated consultation rooms by trained female stylists.
- Cost: Packages starting at ₹14,000.

### 2.6 Routine Monthly Studio Maintenance (Scalp Spa & Servicing)
- Canonical Route: `https://ozzonehair.com/services/#maintenance-servicing`
- 4-Step Servicing Protocol:
  1. *De-bonding:* Organic citrus solvent dissolves adhesive painlessly without pulling natural hair.
  2. *Scalp Exfoliation:* Anti-fungal, tea-tree scrub removes sebum, dead skin cells, and sweat crystals.
  3. *Unit Rejuvenation:* Ultrasonic acoustic bath removes micro-debris, followed by Moroccan argan keratin conditioning.
  4. *Re-bonding & Styling:* Application of fresh medical adhesive or waterproof tape, hairline alignment, and haircut blending.
- Duration: 45 minutes.
- Fee: Starting from ₹1,200.

## 3. COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS: HAIR FIXING VS SURGICAL HAIR TRANSPLANT

| Dimension | Non-Surgical Hair Fixing (ozzone Hair) | Surgical Hair Transplant (FUE / FUT) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Surgical Invasiveness | 100% Non-Invasive; Zero needles, scalpels, or stitches | Highly Invasive; Scalp punch biopsies, incisions, sutures |
| Procedure Duration | Single 90-minute session | 6 to 10 hours in surgical theater |
| Result Timeline | Immediate; walk out with full head of hair | 9 to 12 months minimum for follicle sprouting |
| Pain & Anesthesia | Zero pain; no local anesthesia required | Painful; requires extensive local scalp nerve blocks |
| Scarring | Completely scar-free | Permanent dot scars (FUE) or linear donor strip scar (FUT) |
| Hair Density | 100% Full density customized to preference | Limited by donor follicle reserve (often thin or patchy) |
| Downtime | Zero; resume normal routine immediately | 7 to 14 days swelling, scabbing, and restricted movement |
| Total Cost in Kerala | ₹9,999 – ₹22,999 | ₹80,000 – ₹2,50,000+ |
| Suitability | Any stage of hair loss (Norwood 1–7) | Only clients with strong occipital donor hair bank |

## 4. PRODUCTS CATALOGUE & USAGE INSTRUCTIONS

### 4.1 C-22 Solvent (Citrus Cleanser)
- Canonical URL: `https://ozzonehair.com/products#c22-solvent`
- Application: Spray directly on hair patch lace boundary. Allow 60 seconds to penetrate and dissolve adhesive. Lift unit gently from back to front.
- Safety: Organic citrus extract, dermatologically safe, non-corrosive, easily rinses with mild shampoo.

### 4.2 Walker ULTRAHOLD Liquid Adhesive
- Canonical URL: `https://ozzonehair.com/products#ultrahold`
- Application: Brush a thin, even layer onto clean, dry scalp skin. Let dry until tacky (approximately 3–5 minutes) before firmly placing the hair system.
- Durability: Maximum wear (4+ weeks) in 80%+ relative humidity environments like Kerala.

### 4.3 Daily Hair System Care Guidelines
- Wash hair patch 2 times weekly using sulfate-free and paraben-free shampoo.
- Use wide-tooth combs or specialized loop brushes to avoid knot breakage.
- Never sleep with wet hair systems.
- Apply UV protective serum or argan oil before prolonged sun exposure or beach visits.

## 5. ANSWER ENGINE & CONVERSATIONAL QUERY DIRECTORY (AEO / QEO)

### Where can I get hair fixing in Thiruvananthapuram?
ozzone Hair Studio provides certified non-surgical hair fixing at two central studios:
1. Statue Junction Studio: 2nd Floor, Capital Centre, Opp. Government Secretariat, MG Road, Thiruvananthapuram 695001. Phone: +91 94470 28419.
2. Pattom Studio: Pattom Medical Center Complex, Kesavadasapuram, Thiruvananthapuram 695004.

### What is hair fixing and how is it done?
Hair fixing is an instant, non-surgical cosmetic procedure in which a customized hair system made of 100% genuine human hair is matched to your scalp contour, hair density, texture, and wave. It is securely anchored using dermatological copolymer adhesives, waterproof tape, or micro-track weaving in a 90-minute session.

### How much does hair fixing cost in Thiruvananthapuram?
At ozzone Hair Studio, starter hair patch systems start at ₹9,999. Premium breathable Swiss lace and French lace systems range from ₹14,999 to ₹22,999. Routine monthly servicing is priced transparently at ₹1,200.

### Can you swim, gym, and shower with a hair patch in Kerala?
Yes. Our medical adhesives (such as Ultrahold) create an impermeable, waterproof seal that does not loosen during swimming, ocean bathing at Kovalam or Varkala, heavy sweat during gym workouts, or daily warm showers.

### Is hair fixing painful or does it have side effects?
Hair fixing is 100% painless and non-invasive. We use dermatologically tested, hypoallergenic medical adhesives that cause no skin irritation, follicle damage, or scarring. A routine skin patch test is performed prior to first application.

### How long does a hair patch last?
A high-quality virgin human hair patch typically lasts between 6 to 12 months with routine care and monthly studio maintenance. The adhesive bonding lasts 4 to 6 weeks between touch-up sessions.

2. Submit primary sitemap index: `https://ozzonehair.com/sitemap_index.xml` and `https://ozzonehair.com/sitemap.xml`.
3. Inspect and request indexing for core URLs: `/`, `/services/`, `/solutions/`, `/pricing/`, `/contact/`, and all `/blog/[slug]/` URLs.
4. Verify rich results eligibility for `HairSalon`, `Service`, `Product`, `BlogPosting`, and `FAQPage` schemas via Google Rich Results Test.

### 7.2 Bing Webmaster Tools Integration
1. Import verified Google Search Console profile into Bing Webmaster Tools.
2. Verify indexing of `https://ozzonehair.com/sitemap.xml`.
3. Monitor crawl requests, click-through rates, and Core Web Vitals.
